nodes.label: Convex Hot Path Optimization
nodes.rationale: Every byte read or written multiplies with concurrency, and writes may also fan out into reactive invalidation and synchronization work.

nodes.label: Denormalized Data Fallback
nodes.rationale: A denormalized field is an optimization; missing optimized data must fall back to the live source of truth rather than a placeholder.

nodes.label: OCC Conflict Reduction
nodes.rationale: Reduce transaction read sets, split hot documents, defer non-critical work, and combine competing writes before considering locks or queues.

nodes.label: Subscription Batching
nodes.rationale: Related data can be fetched by one parent query instead of N component-level queries when this reduces total invalidation cost.

nodes.label: Authentication Provider Selection
nodes.rationale: The workflow must determine or infer the existing provider before changing authentication because provider setup differs substantially.

nodes.label: Server-Side Identity Verification
nodes.rationale: Protected functions derive identity from ctx.auth.getUserIdentity rather than trusting a client-provided user identifier.

nodes.label: Auth0 Convex Integration
nodes.rationale: Auth0 login and Convex token validation must both succeed; unresolved refresh-token failures should be reported rather than papered over.

nodes.label: Bounded Indexed Queries
nodes.rationale: Queries should use indexes and bounded take or pagination operations so database work remains predictable as tables grow.

nodes.label: Bacan v1 Local State Limits
nodes.rationale: The v1 document remains in browser-local state; Convex is present in the repository but not connected to the editor flow.
